topic: what a cache does to load time
angle: A cache keeps a nearby copy, so the repeat visit skips the trip to the server.

claims.text: A cache stores a response and reuses it for later requests, so a repeat visit can skip fetching it again.
The 800 ms and 40 ms load times (and "twenty times faster") are illustrative figures chosen for the picture, not a measurement. The film must not present them as measured data.
